title: Enforce provider-neutral usage limits and reviewed reset/restart policies
description: Implement machine-level per-provider/project/session usage monitoring with measured versus estimated/unavailable evidence. Owner can set limits (for example 95 percent), graceful wind-down and a reset-window restart such as Monday 03:20 in their timezone. Do not scrape private account state without approval, invent subscription availability or blindly restart a detached/manually paused fleet. Use conservative invocation budgets where meter data is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Budget crossing gracefully stops new work and preserves in-flight state and resumes under reviewed policy
Missing/stale usage evidence is not zero cost or permission to run unbounded
Per-domain measured usage supports profile changes without silently replacing user selections
Manual pause/detach; credits exhaustion; DST; missed ticks and unknown launches cannot trigger duplicate/unapproved restarts
